title: Personalized, CT-guided antithrombotic therapy versus standard single antiplatelet therapy to reduce thromboembolic and bleeding events in non-atrial fibrillation patients after transcatheter aortic valve implantation: a pragmatic, international, multicentre, randomized clinical trial (POPular ATLANTIS trial)
official: Personalized, CT-guided antithrombotic therapy versus standard antiplatelet therapy to reduce thromboembolic and bleeding events in non-atrial fibrillation patients after transcatheter aortic valve implantation: a pragmatic, international, multicentre, randomized clinical trial (POPular ATLANTIS trial)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate whether a personalized, CT-guided antithrombotic strategy is superior to standard care lifelong SAPT in reducing the risk of cardiovascular mortality, thromboembolic and bleeding events after TAVI in patients without an existing indication for OAC.

interventions.name: Acetylsalicylzuur Cardio Mylan 80 mg, dispergeerbare tabletten
KARDEGIC 75 mg, poudre pour solution buvable en sachet-dose
Ticagrelor Mylan 90 mg comprimidos revestidos por película

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. TAVI with Intended performance of the valve (mean gradient <20 mmHg, peak velocity <3 m/s, Doppler velocity index ≥0.25, and less than moderate aortic regurgitation; according to VARC-3)
2. Ability to understand and to comply with the study protocol
3. Written informed consent
4. Age ≥18 years at enrolment
Exclusion criteria:
1. Existing indication for oral anticoagulation (e.g. atrial fibrillation, obstructive valve thrombosis detected by echocardiography prior to inclusion)
2. Creatinine clearance <30 mL/min (based on the CKD-EPI formula) or on renal replacement therapy
